messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Sun 15 Nov
Quiet Monday: one concert site lists Jack & Jack at Razzmatazz 2 tomorrow, unconfirmed elsewhere - check before going.

TODAY · Sun 15 Nov

1. LasAlturas Market — fashion, food and live music at Gaudí's Torre Bellesguard
🕘 Today · hours not stated · 📍 Torre Bellesguard, Sarrià
📊 1,332 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up; also in their story last night
💶 Ticketed
💬 Stalls, food and live music at a little-known Gaudí house; busy in the city guide's story last night, last day today. Tickets via @lasalturasmarket.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfpf9i8Dbxl/

2. ANTI
🕘 Tonight 20:00 → 05:00 · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 7 interested on RA
💶 12-15-18-20 €
💬 Apolo's Sunday session, tonight doubling as the 15th-anniversary party of Churros con Chocolate, the city's big LGBTQ+ pop night. Starts early, like a tardeo.
https://ra.co/events/2558077

3. Barça vs Monbus Obradoiro — Liga Endesa basketball
🕘 Today 17:00 · 📍 Palau Blaugrana
📊 League home game, 17:00 tip-off per FC Barcelona's calendar and ticket page
💶 Tickets on the club site
💬 An easy way to see Barça live this afternoon: league basketball in the Palau, done in time for dinner or Apolo afterwards.
https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/tickets/basketball/regular/liga-acb/barca-obradoiro

4. CheesyFest — cheese and cheesecake festival
🕘 Today · hours not stated · 📍 Estació Espai Gastronòmic, Av. Marquès de l'Argentera
📊 1,332 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 €3 entry
💬 Cheap food festival with music by the Born, last day. Go early afternoon: an earlier edition's Sunday closed at 18:00 and today's hours are unconfirmed.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfpf9i8Dbxl/

5. SUNDAY VIBES & HAPPY HOUR + STAND UP COMMEDY & LIVE MUSIC
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 00:00 · 📍 OGHAM
📊 58 going on Meetup (limit 250) · group has 49,876 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 The big free international social of the night: happy hour, stand-up and live music in one bar, easy to turn up to with friends.
https://www.meetup.com/language-exchange-barcelona-meetup/events/316811209/

TOMORROW · Mon 16 Nov

1. Sondre Lerche
🕘 Mon 20:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Sala Upload
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €19.84
💬 Norwegian indie-pop songwriter with a long catalogue, in a small room; the one proper touring concert confirmed for Monday.
https://dice.fm/event/wwm2kn-sondre-lerche-16th-nov-sala-upload-barcelona-tickets

2. NOMAD RUN ★ 6KM with Entrepreneurs & Digital Nomads feat. La Fabrica &Co ROOFTOP
🕘 Mon 19:00 → 21:00 · 📍 La Fabrica & Co
📊 18 going on Meetup · group has 15,666 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 A 6 km run with founders and remote workers that ends with drinks on a rooftop; the tech crowd worth meeting.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/316897801/

3. The Monday Language Exchange - Space Cowboy
🕘 Mon 19:00 → 22:00 · 📍 Space Cowboy
📊 16 going on Meetup · group has 63,131 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 The city's largest language-exchange group and its regular Monday bar night; international, relaxed, no ticket needed.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelonalanguageexchange/events/317163534/

4. Doun Doun Mondays feat. Marga Mbande
🕘 Mon 21:00 → 01:00 · 📍 Sidecar
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €12
💬 Seven-piece live afrobeat band with a guest singer and a DJ either side; the liveliest dance floor on a Monday.
https://dice.fm/event/yoqdxp-doun-doun-mondays-feat-marga-mbande-16th-nov-sidecar-barcelona-tickets

5. Jamboree Jam Session
🕘 Mon 19:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Jamboree Jazz Club
📊 #6 of 8 on Xceed by popularity · venue has 5 followers on Xceed
💶 €12
💬 The long-running Monday jazz jam in the Plaça Reial cellar; good musicians, early start, cheap.
https://xceed.me/en/barcelona/event/jamboree-jam-session-29/250166

Scanned: Meetup 213 · RA 21 · DICE 7 · Xceed 8 · Eventbrite 125 · Luma 4 · Instagram 24 posts + 12 stories.
